observations.failure_summary: The focused pre-repair run collected one file and failed exactly three of three contracts: the canonical merge was not independently callable and could not prove that an enclosing positive hit leaves a nested exact zero-hit statement and function at zero; the coverage reporter omitted statement-level JSON; and the provider retained no raw subprocess-evidence directory or copy/rename. The complete ordinary run preserved only those three failures while 1,290 prior tests passed and eight declared skips remained.
